assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production raster atlas for image-prompt-builder hierarchy choice thumbnails.
Primary request: Create exactly ONE 4-column by 3-row contact sheet, twelve equal SQUARE artwork cells. Overall landscape aspect ratio exactly 4:3, ideally 1536x1152. All artwork cells touch at exact x=25%,50%,75% and y=33.333%,66.667%. This is a production sprite atlas that will be cropped into twelve separate thumbnails. Strict regular equal-size grid, not a comic-page layout.
Style/medium: polished soft Japanese anime illustration, elegant delicate linework, soft painterly cel-shading, tasteful lilac/blue/pink/cream colors, detailed but easily readable at thumbnail size. When people are needed, use fully clothed adult women. The images should look consistent as one high-quality interface thumbnail set.
Composition/framing: Every cell independently contains its own full-bleed scene reaching all four edges. The main subject and the specific concept must stay in the central 70% of that cell, leaving generous expendable peripheral background. Do not place important objects within 12% of cell edges. No elements cross from one cell to another. A slight difference in scene background color identifies where artworks meet; NEVER draw lines there.
Exactly twelve scenes in strict row-major order:
Row 1 col 1: hair COLOR, centered shoulder portrait of an elegant adult anime woman with silky gradient hair blending silver, lavender, rosy pink and teal strands, a small natural-looking glimmer, emphasize colored hair rather than decorative effects.
Row 1 col 2: hair FORM, centered upper-body portrait of an elegant adult anime woman with elaborate braided crown leading into wavy twin tails and side-swept bangs, hairstyle fully inside the safe central region.
Row 1 col 3: eyes and EXPRESSION, centered frontal face closeup, sparkling teal and lavender eyes with detailed iris highlights, soft smiling mouth and warm rosy cheeks, face anatomy unambiguous.
Row 1 col 4: skin and BODY PROPORTIONS, graceful fully clothed adult anime woman in a modest fitted turtleneck and long relaxed trousers, full body, natural warm medium-brown skin, clearly visible full silhouette and calm upright posture on a soft cream studio scene.
Row 2 col 1: character RELATIONSHIPS, two adult anime women as affectionate friends in coordinated modest casual clothing, standing side by side and gently linking arms, both faces and their linked arms in the center, soft outdoor bokeh.
Row 2 col 2: artistic MEDIUM, an anime portrait emerging from a watercolor painting with fine pencil strokes and translucent lavender washes, subtle paper texture, include a few small centered painterly brushstrokes, no writing.
Row 2 col 3: INTERIOR setting, cozy richly detailed lavender vintage reading room with a centered upholstered chair, bookshelves, arched window, plants and tea table, room architecture clearly readable.
Row 2 col 4: EXTERIOR setting, whimsical seaside garden path under a pink sky, centered flowering arch and bench overlooking the sea, varied landscape depth and greenery, no people needed.
Row 3 col 1: GRAPHIC and TYPOGRAPHY treatments, centered compact editorial collage of an anime portrait with layered paper shapes, hearts, stars and large expressive abstract typographic letterforms arranged INSIDE the central area only, no frames at cell edges, no cell caption.
Row 3 col 2: LIGHTING, centered adult anime woman in profile with a glowing sunset rim light on her hair and cool violet face shadow, soft strong light beam and luminous floating dust, fully clothed.
Row 3 col 3: COLOR PALETTE, centered graceful adult anime woman in a tailored modest lavender and blush outfit amid carefully coordinated pastel lilac, dusty blue and soft pink botanical shapes, strong harmonious triadic palette impression, no swatch bars or diagrams.
Row 3 col 4: WEATHER, centered adult anime woman in a modest lavender raincoat holding a clear umbrella under sparkling rain with cloudy sky and puddle reflections, raindrops clearly visible but not a border.
Constraints: absolutely NO grid lines, NO separators, NO gutters, NO white horizontal or vertical bands, NO frames around images, NO rounded corners, NO labels, NO numbers, NO captions, NO watermarks. The scene edge is an abrupt crop of artwork, never a line. Do not draw cell-edge borders. Four columns and three rows must be perfectly regular. No extra panels.
assets.coordinates: zero-based source pixels, x/y inclusive, width/height in pixels

verification.note: Visually inspected both generated full-resolution atlases. All 12 scenes have regular 362×362 cell boundaries and no drawn separator lines, white gutters, or cell frames. Crops stay 12 px inside every measured boundary, retaining only the intended scene. Decorative collage material in the graphics cell is intrinsic artwork.
